usageNotes: Use this to define a reusable named alias for an IP address or CIDR range that can then be referenced by name in cluster-level firewall rules. The alias name must start with a letter and can only contain letters, digits, hyphens, and underscores (2–64 characters). Requires the Sys.Modify privilege on the root path '/'.

examples.summary: Create an alias for a trusted management network

tips: Aliases are cluster-wide; once created they are available in both cluster-level and node/VM-level firewall rule editors.
The name pattern requires at least 2 characters and must begin with a letter — purely numeric names are rejected.
Returns null on success; check for a 4xx/5xx HTTP status to detect conflicts (e.g., duplicate alias name).
Alias names are case-sensitive in the API but may display differently in the UI — use consistent casing to avoid confusion.
